description: Bus Frequency is a dataset listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. Bus frequency is measured as the average number of buses per hour along routes in and surrounding census tracts. Coverage: Oakland. The portal files it under the category Equity Indicators. Its tags are bus, equity, equity data, equity indicators, oakland. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Oakland GIS Department by request, 2017; American Community Survey, 5-year estim. The portal shows 2018-07-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
